.engramdb/memories/tax-uses-round-half-even_01a0f9ff-fdd5-79c3-a6ce-9c93a18da31c.md:15:Tax amounts are rounded with banker's rounding (`decimal.ROUND_HALF_EVEN`), as decided with the finance team in March 2026. Do not use ROUND_HALF_UP.

Tax uses banker's rounding, `decimal.ROUND_HALF_EVEN`. The finance team decided this in March 2026, and ROUND_HALF_UP should not be used.

That comes from a stored project decision. I couldn't check it against the code: a search of the repo found no rounding or `quantize` calls outside the memory file, so the rule isn't implemented anywhere yet.
